title: Distance Driven Since the Last Workshop Visit and What Further Cost Is Accepted At
content:
A vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan that has been driven on since the workshop last saw it has less of the further cost accepted. The marketplace's post-loss mileage mark is 500 miles.

- Where the odometer standing on the listing is more than the marketplace's post-loss mileage mark above the highest reading taken at a workshop visit and the listing is live on the marketplace, the further cost is accepted at the marketplace's driven-since share of 90 percent.
- Where it is more than that mark above and the listing is not live, it is accepted at the marketplace's laid-up share of 95 percent.
- Where it is not more than that mark above, it is accepted in full.

### Both sides of the mark (hypothetical figures)

Take a highest workshop reading of 62000 miles.

| Odometer on the listing | Listing live | Accepted at |
|---|---|---|
| 62501 | yes | 90 percent |
| 62501 | no | 95 percent |
| 62500 | either | the whole of it |

A difference of exactly 500 miles is not more than the mark, and the cost is accepted whole.

### Source of the readings

The odometer standing on the listing and whether the listing is live are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Listing for that vehicle; the highest reading taken at a workshop visit is read from the workshop record held on the vehicle.
